summary: Two round ids, each saved twice. r-0004-retry repeats the same payload after h1 was resolved: it assembles once and does not reopen h1. r-0005-conflict carries a different payload the second time: the earliest copy assembles, so its h3 mark is not shown, and the id is reported as a conflict naming both copies. The CLI's v1 reader hides h3 with only a log line.
